6172.title: Pool recovery leaves retry decisions stale
6172.rootCauseOneLine: Provider Retry queries pool availability only on turn.failed and never reconciles fixed schedules or declined decisions after pool recovery or plugin reload.
6172.proposedFix: Add a pool availability change path and retry reconciliation with safe core queue rescheduling, bounded recovery, and original-request validity checks. This crosses subsystems and contract decisions, so it is outside the automatic simple-fix gate.
6172.caveats: Four integration scenarios reproduced twice with real plugin entries and real SQLite storage; no live provider accounts. Plugin reload is not a process restart. Individual non-enable recovery triggers and stale-request drain behavior were not dynamically reproduced. Reproduction test and output are inline per public reports repository policy.
